county.title: Miami-Dade DTPW sidewalk inventory
county.note: Sidewalks owned by Miami-Dade Transportation and Public Works. Width, length, and ADA fields were empty on most features in this window and are not used.

osm.title: OpenStreetMap footways
osm.note: Mapped sidewalks, crossings, steps, pedestrian streets, and named paths. These are not county surveys.

transit.title: Miami-Dade Metromover stations
transit.note: OPEN_ is the county attribute retrieved 2026-11-05. It is not a live operating check.

proposed.name: I-395 Baywalk pedestrian bridge
proposed.note: Miami DDA describes a missing Baywalk link under the MacArthur Causeway between Maurice A. Ferré Park and the former Herald Plaza. On 2026-02-20 the DDA preferred Bay 2 Enhanced Connector, and on 2026-03-12 the City Commission recommended that design. No alignment coordinates were published in a form this study can draw.

provenance.countyFeatureIds: Not retained. Stored sidewalk ids are sequence labels such as county-1.
provenance.osmRequest: Not retained. OpenStreetMap way ids are stored, including osm-770673514 for the named Baywalk. The recorded OSM URL is the copyright page.
provenance.coordinateRequest: The file records international feet, with X east and Z north. The spatial reference requested from the county service was not stored.
provenance.widths: Width and ADA values are not in this file, so the retrieval statement that those fields were empty cannot be rechecked from the stored features.
